Close-ups in the corners show each blade’s angle of attack, and a note reads “Must check all props rotation direction before take off!”
image101.png.caption: Each propeller’s pitch must match its motor’s direction. This quadcopter uses reversed (“props out”) directions, the mirror image of the Betaflight default used in this chapter. On your quadcopter, match each propeller to the direction you checked in the Motors tab.
